 Bigg Boss 20: Will Qazi’s Manifestation Turn Into Reality?
 Qazi Touqeer's manifestation of clinching the Bigg Boss trophy will be revealed in the upcoming episode of Bigg Boss 20. Will his ultimate dream come true? Read for details. 
 Author: IWMBuzz Editorial Team 
 Published: 21 Oct,2026 06:10:23 PM 
 From the very first day inside the Bigg Boss 20 house, Qazi Touqeer has grabbed the spotlight, instantly commanding attention through his trademark antics, unpredictable talks, and larger-than-life energy. Whether he is staging dramatic late-night acts that leave his fellow housemates sleepless and bewildered or effortlessly anchoring conversations with his unique charm, Qazi has proven he is unlike anyone else in the game.
 As his journey navigates through shifting alliances, intense weekly tasks, and emotional highs and lows, Qazi keeps his eyes firmly fixed on the ultimate prize. In the upcoming episodes, amid discussions about dream checklists and game milestones, Qazi will open up about his deepest aspiration: he will visualise himself walking out of the house clutching the winner’s trophy.
 Looking ahead into his journey, Qazi will vividly talk about his winning moment, painting a picture of his grand homecoming. He will express his unshakeable confidence that he will lift the trophy and take it back home to Srinagar, where he will celebrate his historic victory right alongside his people at Ghanta Ghar.
 As the competition inches ahead in the house, the big question remains: Will Qazi Touqeer be able to turn this powerful manifestation into reality, or will the unpredictable twists of the house rewrite his destiny?
 Watch this space at IWMBuzz.com for updates.
